subtitle: A fixture for check-provenance.sh
description: Two chapters whose provenance marks exercise every verdict check-provenance.sh can reach through a markdown source: a mark that resolves, a source the book never declared, a heading the source does not carry, a paragraph tag and a chapter number the book does not define, a quotation that is in the source, a quotation that is in the source under different punctuation, and a quotation that is nowhere.

Chapter 1 holds only passing marks, so a run that reports anything against it is a regression. Chapter 2 holds one of each failing shape, each named in the line above it. Expected: 6 failures and 1 review, exit 1 under check-provenance.sh, and exit 0 under check-book.sh. Both are asserted by scripts/test-fixtures.sh and run in CI; update this sentence and the manifest there in the same edit that adds or removes a case.
The page and slide range checks are NOT covered here, because a fixture for them would mean committing a PDF and a .pptx. They are exercised against real course material instead, in a private repo.

The two chapters were split into two parts each on 2026-09-23. A chapter's shape is two or three part headings and each carried one, so check-book.sh failed the whole folder on a structural rule neither chapter was written to exercise, and its exit code said nothing about provenance either way.
